title: Ask why the ordinary work went well
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Reconstruct the decisions — Notice the choices that made the work manageable.; Inspect the conditions — Separate repeatable support from chance and hidden effort.; Test a plausible variation — Ask whether the practice survives a relevant change.; Preserve one lesson — Put a specific insight where future work can use it..
